changes.title: Experimental scoring explained
changes.text: An optional scoring popup explains my plans for interacting rules and character progression without changing today's provisional multipliers.

changes.title: Scoring information on small screens
changes.text: Android checks open and scroll the scoring explanation, then return with Back while preserving the selected rules and score.

changes.title: Verified lunch delivery records
changes.text: Private APK and report delivery records preserve exact source, checksums, signing checks and actual publication times.

commentary: I moved the longer scoring explanation into an optional native popup so it stays separate from the controls. The current357 provisional values and scoring calculation are unchanged; future interaction-aware and character-specific scoring are ideas, not promised features.
